elementName: Duty or tax or fee rate basis code

values.name: Value
values.description: (5316) To specify that the applicable rate of duty, tax or fee is based on the Customs value (CCC).

values.name: Weight
values.description: (6150) To specify that the applicable rate of duty, tax or fee is based on the weight of the item (CCC).

values.name: Quantity
values.description: (6060) To specify that the applicable rate of duty, tax or fee is based on the quantity of the item (CCC).
